```plato
//==
// # Lattice instances
//
// A cell placed in the world: repeated Counts times per axis so that the
// repetitions exactly fill Bounds. Cell size is therefore derived, never stored
// — `CellSize` in `lattices.library.plato` divides the bounds extent by the
// counts, which is what keeps a node shared by two neighbouring cells at one
// world position and makes the struts weld without a search.
// Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Bounds.

// A strut lattice: one unit cell tiled Counts times per axis across Bounds,
// with struts of the given world-space radius. Radius is nominal — the graded
// operators in `lattices.library.plato` produce a per-strut radius array from a
// field instead, and leave this value alone.
type StrutLattice3D
    implements IValue, IBounded3D
{
    Cell: LatticeUnitCell;
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
    Counts: IntegerVector3;
    Radius: Number;
}
```
